name: Suchanek Gerlinde
beschreibung:
This entry lists Suchanek Gerlinde as a hotel in the town of Reutte in the Außerfern region. Reutte is the administrative seat of the district of the same name and lies on the Lech, nestled between the Tannheimer Berge, the Lechtaler Alpen and the Ammergauer Alpen. The region bears the nickname „Gateway to Tyrol“ and is a starting point for hiking and winter sports around the Hahnenkamm mountain world and the surrounding valleys.

Well-known destinations of the Reutte Nature Park region include the Ehrenberg castle world with the highline179 suspension bridge, the Alpentherme Ehrenberg, as well as the Plansee and the Heiterwanger See. The Tiroler Lech Nature Park protects one of the last wild river landscapes of the Alps.
